title: UE requested bearer resource modification procedure initiation

entities.name: UE requested bearer resource modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to modify bearer resources for traffic flow aggregates, including GBR changes, packet filter modifications, header compression re-negotiation, and 3GPP PS data off status changes.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to MME to request modification of bearer resources for traffic flow aggregates.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity for packet filter
entities.description: IE containing the EPS bearer identity of the EPS bearer associated with the traffic flow aggregate.

entities.name: Traffic flow aggregate
entities.description: IE containing TFT operation code and packet filter information for modifying traffic flow aggregates.

entities.name: Required traffic flow QoS
entities.description: IE indicating the new GBR requested for the EPS bearer context.

entities.name: Header compression configuration
entities.description: IE used for re-negotiation of header compression configuration associated to an EPS bearer context.

entities.name: Protocol configuration options
entities.description: IE used to indicate change of 3GPP PS data off UE status.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options
entities.description: IE containing service-level-AA container for C2 communication authorization.

entities.name: T3481
entities.description: Timer started when UE sends BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING
entities.description: State entered by UE after sending BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message.

entities.name: Header compression support condition
entities.description: Condition requiring network and UE to support control plane CIoT EPS optimization and header compression.

entities.name: 3GPP PS data off support condition
entities.description: Condition requiring network to have indicated 3GPP PS data off support during PDN connection establishment.

relations.description: Procedure involves sending BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message
Message contains EPS bearer identity for packet filter IE
Message contains traffic flow aggregate IE
Message contains required traffic flow QoS IE for GBR changes
Message contains header compression configuration IE when conditions met
Message contains protocol configuration options IE for 3GPP PS data off status changes
Message contains extended protocol configuration options IE for C2 communication authorization
Procedure starts timer T3481 when UE sends request message
Procedure requires UE to enter PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING state
Inclusion of header compression configuration IE is guarded by header compression support condition
Inclusion of protocol configuration options IE for 3GPP PS data off is guarded by support condition
